long_biography.plain_text:
Keith MacPhail grew up in Medicine Hat and spent summers working in oilfields before studying petroleum technology and engineering. His operating career took him through Poco Petroleums to Canadian Natural Resources, where he became chief operating officer. He then helped establish Bonavista Energy and later NuVista Energy, spending years in their leadership and on their boards. The two oil and gas producers, rather than his later directorships, best explain his business career and documented source of wealth.

MacPhail also chaired Cenovus through a period of corporate change, retiring from its board in 2023 and from NuVista's in 2024. A recent profile describes him as retired apart from service on a couple of unnamed private boards; their economic significance is not public. With his wife, Kathy, he supported a major gift to the Southern Alberta Institute of Technology. Its MacPhail School of Energy carries their name. The couple also helped fund a Calgary cancer-screening centre. His philanthropy follows a career rooted in the region's petroleum industry.
